stem.text: The drug cortisone has the formula shown.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of cortisone: a steroid with four fused rings, ketone groups at the top ring and at the left ring, a C(OH) carbon bearing a C(=O)CH2OH side chain, and chiral centres marked by asterisks.

stem.text: In addition to those chiral centres marked by an asterisk (*), how many **other** chiral centres are present in the cortisone molecule?
